notes: playfield per event = the state at that time. playfields_visited = every playfield the state reached (ctrack exit or enter_game after a request). Sources: the client's teleport RPCs (TeleportMe, TeleportWindowBypass, TeleportMessageBoxAnswer > 0) and ctrack analytics (enter/exit_splashscreen 51100:<id>, enter_game). 'unknown' while loading, after an enter_game with no matching request, and before the first arrival. Server replies are not in the capture; Endless answers name no destination.
